allowedAdditions.__wbg___wbindgen_string_get_e4f06c90489a: Accepts a primitive string, transfers it via existing TextEncoder/WASM allocation, and writes pointer/length to WASM memory.

assessment: The exact CI-generated import bodies contain string/memory operations only: no network, filesystem, process, DOM, WASI, eval or other host-I/O capability was found in these four additions.

Rust strict_text first rejects nonprimitive strings, bounds UTF-16 length, rejects unpaired surrogates, bounds calculated UTF-8 byte length, and confirms final UTF-8 length after transfer. The imports support these existing checks; the patch does not alter them.
Cargo.lock pins wasm-bindgen0.2.105 and js-sys0.3.82. Four hashed names are added exactly; no broad new prefix or wildcard is introduced.
The boolean predicate still rejects every non-wbg module and every non-function import, including imports with one of the newly allowed names. The existing legacy throw-name prefix is unchanged.

Static inverse-diff comparison confirms every byte outside the new four-name set, its explanatory comment and membership disjunct is unchanged. All response-count/exact-byte parity checks, Node-global checks, bad-transport/surrogate and trap controls, host-I/O stubs and request checks remain.
